tasks.short: Support recruitment, registration and cultural-studies placement

steps.what: Participate in actual student recruitment and discuss cultural-studies course options
outputs: Actual program discussion and identified course interests

steps.what: Receive and check actual registration evidence and previous coursework
inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing student registration and course-placement system
outputs: Verified case evidence and unresolved qualifications

steps.what: Compare verified course codes and registration fields with the actual declared prerequisite and completeness rules
inputs: Explicit current course-code and required-field rules
outputs: Exact matches, incomplete fields and unmatched qualifications

steps.what: Resolve actual registration exceptions and advise on suitable placement with the student and responsible staff
outputs: Actual placement recommendation and pending or resolved case status

steps.what: Capture the actual required case entry and check its complete final evidence, placement recommendation and status
inputs: Actual case outcome and source documents
outputs: Complete checked final registration case entry

steps.what: Save the exact checked registration case entry
inputs: Exact final case entry checked in s5
outputs: Saved case entry with actual decision status

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} checks for exact course-code prerequisites and registration completeness. The teacher retains recruitment discussion, evidence verification, placement exceptions and actual case-record capture and checking before its separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual checks of known course codes and registration fields add handling to case support.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing student-system rules can check exact declared requirements without a predictive admission model.
tasks.still_hard: Nonstandard qualifications and suitable academic placement require authorized people and student discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher connects the student's goals and preparation to actual cultural-studies options.

ambition.what: Reduce exact-match handling within existing case support.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native student-system rules can compare verified course codes with declared prerequisites and flag incomplete registration fields.

assumptions: Unmeasured registration-support episode spanning actual recruitment and placement discussion; shares are independent of the prompt prior. Other recruitment activities have different work mixes.
Students supply actual documents; s2 counts receipt and verification. Missing evidence or unrecognized qualifications require manual resolution in s4. No clean feed is assumed free.
s3 replaces actual manual exact matching only. Existing equivalent checks earn no additional benefit. No model selects applicants, grades qualifications or assigns education levels.

s5 counts actual required case capture and complete final checking. The saved case honestly records pending decisions and does not issue a hidden admission offer, placement letter or notification. The effectively immediate save earns no saving; changed evidence or status requires renewed checking.
Gross 15 minus 2 incremental upkeep gives 13 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
unknowns: Actual manual rule matching and teacher case responsibilities
research_questions: Which checks remain manual in the student system?

already_counted.description: Retained evidence verification, exception discussion and complete final case capture and checking

incremental.description: Maintain exact prerequisite rules and test changed course identifiers

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete case entry and actual decision status checked in s5; changed evidence or status requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 15 exact-match hours removed minus 2 upkeep = 13 net. Existing equivalent checks reduce additional benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check the organization's actual question and current institutional or organization guidance
inputs: Current organization constitution and applicable institution guidance

steps.what: Act as adviser to the student organization during the actual discussion of its plans and concerns
outputs: Organization receives actual advice and identifies its own next steps

tasks.design: Keep the current organization guidance at a stable location in {DOCS}. The teacher retrieves and checks it, then advises the student officers personally about their actual plans.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current constitution or institution guidance can add preparation to an advisory conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and version labels make existing guidance easier to find.
tasks.still_hard: Student relationships, organizational choices and situation-specific advice require people.
tasks.human_edge: The adviser helps students think through decisions while respecting their responsibility for the organization.

ambition.what: Reduce guidance retrieval around existing advisory conversations.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document links can reduce retrieval of current organization guidance while retaining actual advisory discussion.

assumptions: Unmeasured advisory conversation with actual guidance retrieval; shares are independent of the prompt prior. If guidance is already at hand, there is no lookup saving.
Student officers produce their request and plans; existing owners maintain the constitution and institution guidance. s1 counts retrieval and verification, and s2 counts the actual advisory exchange.

No meeting minutes, approval letter, event booking, budget transaction or follow-up message is established in this episode. Those actions are not invented or assumed free. Any actual required write or send would need separate preparation, final checking and a gate.
No recurring calendar setup is charged to the conversation. Gross 3 minus 1 upkeep gives 2 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
research_questions: Which organization questions need document retrieval?

already_counted.description: Retained context retrieval and current-guidance verification

incremental.description: Keep actual organization guidance links current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 15 times 20% = 3 gross, minus 1 upkeep = 2 net. Actual advice is fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect and verify the actual government or industry consulting brief, relevant records and source evidence
inputs: Actual client brief and permitted records
Actual relevant scholarly and contextual sources
outputs: Checked consulting evidence and unresolved information gaps

steps.what: Discuss the client's actual objectives, cultural context and constraints
outputs: Clarified consulting problem and actual client constraints

steps.what: Analyze the actual evidence and formulate professional findings, advice and limitations
Write and edit the actual client advice document from the teacher's authored findings

loop.purpose: Draft wording for the actual written consulting advice
loop.input: Teacher-authored findings, verified evidence and agreed format
loop.output: Draft advice with source-linked claims and unchanged recommendations
loop.check: Teacher edits every claim against evidence and actual authored recommendations
loop.stop: Missing facts, unsupported claims or changed recommendations require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Client-specific explanations require semantic wording beyond a fixed template

steps.what: Check the complete final advice, evidence, limitations, confidentiality and actual client recipient
inputs: Actual client confidentiality terms and recipient
outputs: Exact checked final client advice and recipient

steps.what: Send the exact checked final consulting advice to the actual client recipient
inputs: Exact final advice and recipient checked in s5
outputs: Client receives the professional advice document

tasks.design: Use a bounded {DOCS} draft only for wording of the teacher's actual professional findings. Keep source collection, client discussion, analysis and complete final advice checking with the teacher, then send the exact checked version separately through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing client-facing explanations adds effort after substantive consulting analysis is complete.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can express supplied findings in the agreed format while preserving source links for checking.
tasks.still_hard: Cultural interpretation, client context and professionally defensible recommendations remain expert work.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher owns the advice and its limits in the actual client's situation.

ambition.what: Reduce writing effort for an existing agreed consulting deliverable.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for client confidentiality and permitted drafting-context consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded language drafting can express supplied consulting findings in client-facing prose subject to complete expert checking.

assumptions: Unmeasured consulting episode with an actual agreed written advice deliverable, not a report invented after every client conversation. Shares are independent of the prompt prior; other consulting engagements need their observed work mix.

Client representatives supply actual records; s1 counts collection and verification, s2 actual clarification and s3 analysis and findings authorship. No free completed findings or clean source dataset is assumed.

Use existing document templates first. The loop is only for permitted semantic drafting; confidential material is used only in the actually authorized context. If drafting assistance is not allowed or claims cannot be checked, retain manual writing.

s4 includes substantive editing and source checks; s5 is the complete final-version check, not an invented additional management approval. s6 is a separate immediate gated send with no saving. Any edit or recipient change voids the gate.
Advice does not exercise government or company decision authority, issue an official determination or create hidden commitments. Gross 8 minus 2 upkeep gives 6 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
unknowns: Actual written deliverable and permitted drafting context
Current template use and drafting effort
research_questions: How much writing remains after the actual recommendations are authored?

already_counted.description: Retained source collection, substantive analysis, draft editing and complete final-advice checking

incremental.description: Maintain permitted drafting context and source-linked advice checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete client advice and recipient checked in s5; changed wording or destination requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 20 times 40% = 8 gross, minus 2 upkeep = 6 net. Source work, client discussion, analysis and final checking remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Registration owners retain actual case authority.
Client representatives supply actual consulting evidence and constraints.
skills_to_grow: Check drafted advice against authored findings and evidence
role.ambitious_version: A cultural-studies teacher with less repetitive rule checking and advice drafting while retaining student support, professional judgment and accountability.

job.title: Area, Ethnic, and Cultural Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
